subject: Film & Cinema
title: D.W. Griffith: Inventor and Controversy
description: One-minute skill: D.W. Griffith: Inventor and Controversy.

hook.text: D.W. Griffith invented close-ups, cross-cutting, and the feature film — then used them for racism.

buildup.text: The Birth of a Nation in 1915 was a technical marvel and a moral catastrophe.

discovery.text: Griffith's editing innovations are still used in every film made today.

twist.text: He tried to atone with Intolerance, an anti-bigotry epic, but the damage was done.

climax.text: His legacy forces cinema to confront how innovation and harm can coexist.

punchline.text: He built film language. Its first sentence was hateful.

quiz.question: Why is D.W. Griffith's legacy controversial?
options: He pioneered film techniques but used them in a deeply racist film
